question: Is the factual action→consequence task learnable by a budget-matched conventional trainable content-retrieval model given exactly the same factual events and final observed query, while original four-block hybrid remains unable to acquire the same associations under the same number of optimizer steps?

source.generation: Independent per-world orthogonal 16D target action keys with independent continuous tanh-valued 16D observed effects; each repeated twice; eight distinct random normalized nuisance actions and effects; events uniformly shuffled per world with seeded RNG; one simulated actually executed delayed target query, whose true consequence is a supervised target revealed only after all writes.
source.secrecy: History API sees action key and observed effect of actually executed simulated past actions; never future query, withheld consequence, evaluator role or index; test no target-role position leakage.
source.source_separation: All P65-P72 previously seen/consumed seeds and examples forbidden; no independent sealed physical source; P73 has NO OOD outcome generation or scoring in this gate.

arms.trained_conventional: Metricized content-addressed conventional retrieval: positive query-key normalized cosine in a 16x16 trainable projection, softmax temperature learned from deliberately low starting gain, values are actually observed factual consequences. Single forward pass over factual history. No role/time/future target during history write. 257 learned parameters and full 24x32-float history retained; report memory mismatch instead of equal-state claim.
arms.classical_fixed: Fixed raw-key cosine softmax temperature 8 with actual effects; no learned parameters. Report as distinct nonprivileged control; it may be stronger than trainable arm.
arms.frequency_cache: P72's exact 256-float conventional key/effect cache, no gradient; diagnostic only.
arms.original_all_write: Exact unchanged four-block native P71 original, trained from separately seeded initialization per model seed; no modifications to original model.py
arms.original_gate: Exact original four-block native P71 with P70 frozen gate, paired identical initialization and FIT batches with all-write.
arms.negative: Trainable conventional retrieval on each world's shuffled action/effect pairing; final query's true outcome unchanged, measure trained model's validation consequence MSE to test action-credit dependence; no hidden oracle.
arms.zero: All-zero baseline vs withheld query label

training.best: Validation-only best checkpoint per arm; log all 20-step validation points, pretrained/initial performance, parameter counts, optimizer and memory, and distinct SHA256 for independent initializations.
training.pairing: Same FIT/VAL factual-world tensors and sample indices for each arm; same initial full-model tensor state across all-write versus gate on each seed; gate is fixed and not retrained on P73; all models get the same executed past observations and final-query supervised label.
training.qualification: 120 updates alone do NOT prove convergence of any model. Label limited-budget comparison explicitly; do not call fully trained conventional baseline if loss still improving.

controls.source: FIT+VAL role imbalance per 4 quartiles <=0.05; heldout index-only balanced accuracy <=0.55; no future query or outcome in historical updates; float finiteness; exact novel seed registry.
controls.trainable_competence: All three conventional seeds achieve <=0.60*zero VAL MSE AND <=0.85*their independently measured initialized VAL MSE after 120 updates; else P73 DEV_FAIL_INCOMPETENT_RETRIEVAL. Independently trained negative-action-credit scores >=1.5x correct conventional VAL MSE per seed.
controls.hybrid_criterion: Each hybrid mode per seed qualifies only if its best VAL MSE <=0.85*zero VAL MSE; if fewer than all six qualify, previous full-hybrid deficiency not disproven.
controls.negative: Wrong-credit conventional learner must fail per seed, fixed raw similarity and frequency controls must be reported; no fresh data reuse in retroactive tuning.
controls.fairness: Same data, actions, labels, minibatches and optimizer update count; state storage and trainable parameter/FLOP cost unequal and MUST be reported; no superiority claim on matched compute.
controls.diagnostic_PASS: All source/negative/custody controls pass, 3/3 conventional learner qualifies, and >=2/3 paired seeds have BOTH original all-write and gated Hybrid validation competence fail. Classify as DEV_DIAGNOSTIC_SUPPORTED_END_TO_END_HYBRID_LEARNING_PATH, NOT proof that one specific representation block is defective.
controls.outcome_if_hybrid_qualifies: FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE as preregistered; do not relabel as hybrid scientific gain.
controls.STOP: No OOD data generated or scored for P73 even on diagnostic PASS; only author-generated fresh FIT/VAL source; no independent scientific claim.
controls.independent_science: Separate owner-authenticated first-use source, stronger matched compute and fully trained conventional hybrid baselines, cross-platform full regression, transfer/cold-retention/causal-shift required for SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
